annotation.bound_parties_text: The proposed regulations bind autonomous vehicle manufacturers (permit applicants and holders), and also test drivers, remote drivers and remote assistants, with the department and peace officers having processes defined.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Manufacturers would be required to meet existing state and federal commercial vehicle requirements for the type of vehicle being operated and the type of commerce being carried out
annotation.robot_provision_quote: related to the testing and deployment of autonomous vehicles.
